# Mika artwork and blog footer provenance

`mika-pose-point.png` is an unchanged Mech project artwork asset copied from
`public/post/2026-05-11-version-0.3/images/mika-pose-point.png` in the official
`mech-lang/web/website` checkout at revision
`0ed4a4bf8c4b02300a31668263d5e22abbbe045f`.

- SHA-256: `f1d3eaca93ca8e3befa0774d70e0ac850ff7ad8435af68f1da30f34061d91119`
- Dimensions: 671 × 506 pixels, RGBA PNG.
- Original asset URL used by the official footer:
  <https://gitlab.com/mech-lang/assets/-/raw/main/images/mika/mika-pose-point.png?ref_type=heads>
- Official publication and artwork disclosure:
  <https://mech-lang.org/post/2026-05-11-version-0.3/#16559846594846380>

The publication credits the Mech project's Mika artwork and discloses the
use of AI image tools. This copy adds no new license grant for the artwork;
the separate `OFL.txt` font license does not apply to Mika.

`../footer.html` preserves the official v0.3 blog footer's DOM hierarchy,
classes, inline SVG icons, link groups, release card, copyright, and responsive
mini/micro Mika glyphs. Its local image URL includes intrinsic dimensions to
reserve the artwork's aspect ratio. Platform placeholder links and documentation
links use the official site's existing destinations; the Mika link targets the
verified introduction in the v0.3 post.

The workshop footer identifies its compiled v0.4.0-beta build and links to the
build manifest. It does not claim that a corresponding GitHub release has been
published. The date matches the workshop article's September 27, 2026 date.

`../separator.html` preserves the blog's decorative Mika separator. Insert it
after the article layout and before the footnotes/works-cited backmatter. Insert
the footer after the backmatter, inside the content column. Both use the current
shared `include/style.css` without a separate footer stylesheet.
